findings.current: 未发布任何内容。请重新登录Radient，以替换中心拒绝的凭据，然后重新发布。
findings.problem: Style guide: 请 only where the English says 'please'. The English refusal copy is a bare imperative, and 19 of the new publication strings add 请 (hub_unauthorized.body/body_pull, hub_unavailable.body/body_pull, insufficient_role.*, moderation_unavailable.body, name_claim_in_flight.body, name_taken.owned_body, not_a_member.*, payload_too_large.*, pull.busy, pull.incomplete, team_plan_required.*). Shipped zh-CN does use 请 freely, so this is a register deviation with precedent, not a meaning error.
findings.proposed: Drop 请 and keep the verb forward: '未发布任何内容。重新登录Radient，以替换中心拒绝的凭据，然后重新发布。' (same edit across the 19 keys).

findings.current: 中心拒绝下载，{subject}不在本机。
findings.problem: Subject attribution: EN says the hub refused the download REQUEST (4xx), so the document is not here. 拒绝下载 reads as 'the hub declined to download', making the hub the actor of a download it never attempts.
findings.proposed: 中心拒绝了这次下载请求，{subject}不在本机。

findings.problem: The transitive verb 发布 has no object here, so 已不再发布 can be read as 'no longer publishes' (intransitive). The sibling body already uses 下架 for the same fact.
findings.proposed: 该团队已下架  (or 该团队已不再公开发布)
